source.title: Index theory and elliptic boundary value problems. Remarks and open problems

evidence.quote: Index theory and elliptic boundary value problems. Remarks and open problems ... Bernhelm Booss, Bert Schulze Banach Center Publications 10 (1983), 33-57 DOI: 10.4064/-10-1-33-57

The paper may serve both as an interesting informal survey of results, methods and ideas which concern the famous Atiyah-Singer index theorem and its applications, and as a survey of some new results and open problems concerning the index theory of elliptic boundary value problems.
